<p>We saw many things this weekend and this week in college football that demonstrate how fickle college football truly is. For example:</p><p>&nbsp;Franklin James was fired from Penn State and was 4th in wins during the last four years!? (This makes eight head coaching openings across the country and all but two are in Power 4 conference schools. That’s eight buyouts for head coaches AND, something not mentioned that often, <em>all</em> <em>the assistant coaches </em>before paying for a <em>new </em>roster of coaches.) Goodbye NIL $!</p><p>&nbsp;Speaking of head coaching vacancies, in pigville, interim coach petrino won a true moral victory losing to the volatiles by just 3 points and leading most of the game.</p><p>&nbsp;In other unpredictable behavior, kirby smart decided <em>publicly </em>that telling the truth was optional and changed his clapping style to resemble a time out signal. I guess he didn’t want to contribute to the auburn home crowd advantage with additional noise opting for this subtle change of gestures?! But leaving the <em>question</em> of his character to remain a constant in everyone’s mind. You should go be in time out yourself, kirby!</p><p>&nbsp;<img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Image.jpeg" height="275" width="234"></p><p>&nbsp;&nbsp;And scorned with chants of “over-rated” for weeks, arch manning grew up before our eyes and pulverized the undefeated okies.</p><p>&nbsp;With all the inconsistencies in life, there are few things we know to be true where we can completely put our trust…but they exist:</p><p>&nbsp;Coach DeBoer’s “black hoodie of death” (as dubbed by mizzou coach eli drinkwitz last weekend) came back to a local shop for repair this week…is it made of drier lint or something? And if not, is Coach DeBoer organizing illegal cock fights in that shirt in the pre or post-game? I don’t KNOW that would be a violation of NCAA rules but I kind of do know…you know what I mean? That hoodie needs kid-glove care for sure. You may have caught the stat at the end of the broadcast of the Alabama vs. mizzouri game when Coach DeBoer was being interviewed, “Black Hoodie 12-2” was shown underneath while he spoke about the win which means the hoodie is likely going to get the big head soon and demand NIL or threaten to go to the transfer portal. But bring it on! We can handle the hoodie’s demands for fabric softener, dry cleaning, etc. </p><p>&nbsp;And as mentioned, the voodoo in jordan-hare stadium continued this past weekend, but this time, it went against the boogs. And as a result, the aubs are starting to worry they will miss having a former head coach’s buy-out to pay. They will be free and clear of Bryan Harsin’s buy-out payments in 2026. So, despite the continued government shut-down, as the rumbles increase for firing freeze and even AD john cohen, we can rest easy knowing the auburn head coach welfare program should remain intact.&nbsp;</p><p>&nbsp;And, of course, the most faithful thing we can count on is upon us…Alabama fans’ hatred of tennessee…it’s tennessee Hate Week! Woohoo! And since the Tide broke both georgia’s NCAA home field winning streak and then mizzou’s sec home field winning streak, Alabama has the new home field winning streak on the line this weekend! (OK, we are actually tied with the Boise St. Bronco’s who host UNLV this weekend but that’s not real football. Just the same…let’s go UNLV Rebels!) Plus, we need revenge on the volatiles for hazing Coach DeBoer by beating him when he was a new boy last year! That’s not cool anymore. And Jason Wear, don’t be screaming in response to winning streaks and revenge, “Don’t jinx it!” It is important to remind ourselves what is on the line…it’s the return of the cockiness that is….Alabama football!</p><p>&nbsp;The football gods have brought us a truly <em>exceptional</em> schedule of games this weekend and the football starts Tuesday night! So, despite what’s going on in the world, we got it good on Saturday! RTR and Enjoy Week 8!</p><p>&nbsp;Jackie&nbsp;</p>
